no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred for review to an advisory committee because the safety profile of golodirsen is acceptable for the intended population, the clinical trial designs were acceptable, and the findings on the surrogate marker were clear.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA211970 (VYONDYS 53 / golodirsen). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the safety profile was acceptable, the trial designs were acceptable, and the surrogate marker findings were clear; the Medical Review independently confirms an AC was not felt necessary. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
